entrypoint: trap 'kill "$child"; exit 0' TERM INT; tail -f /dev/null & child=$!; wait "$child"

cpuMillis.description:
CPU ceiling in thousandths of a core (CFS quota). Also what the JVM counts as its
processors. Absent: no ceiling, weight only.

cpuWeight.description: Share of CPU under contention, relative (cgroup weight). Absent: proportional to memory.

memoryMb.description: Hard memory limit (no swap). Expressed in MiB.

pidsLimit.description: Processes and threads. Absent: the host default (4096).

mountPath.description: Where the workload's persistent data appears inside it.

sizeGb.description:
The size the control plane promised. Reported against measured usage; not enforced in v1
(no per-directory quota on a plain filesystem).
